contract: Meta Trio v2 assessment contract (js/schema.js; FIRST_RESPONSE.md section 4). Assessment categories are the ignis categories in js/products.js.
ground_truth_note: Current-taxonomy set: the frozen 20 scenarios (IGN-001..020) plus one scenario per fire-type and smoke-type category the js/products.js taxonomy grew on 2026-10-31 (IGN-021..030). Labels in this file were authored before any assessment source was run against them. The adapter reads this file read-only and never mutates it. A scenario's ground_truth_label is the visible condition a reviewer would record from the described scene; alert_expected is true when the scene shows a hazard category that fires an alert under the current taxonomy. 'obscured or distant hazard' never fires an alert on its own; 'steam or fog' and 'flame-like lighting' are confusable negatives, never alerts. Scenes are to be sourced as prerecorded footage or safe visual demonstrations only; never create a real fire to test this product.

scenarios.evidence_note: A distinct grey plume rising against a clear sky, source visible in frame.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A plume of grey smoke rising from a rooftop vent stack in daylight, clearly visible against the sky.
scenarios.title: Visible smoke plume, daylight

scenarios.evidence_note: Flames clearly visible in the footage; the footage itself is the evidence, not a live fire.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Prerecorded footage displayed on a screen showing open flames in a room, flames clearly visible and moving.
scenarios.title: Visible flames, prerecorded footage

scenarios.evidence_note: Smoke column backlit and visible despite low light; exact source not distinguishable.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A column of smoke at night under a streetlight, drifting across a dark sky, shapes visible but colors muted.
scenarios.title: Visible smoke, poor lighting

scenarios.evidence_note: Flames plus a smoke plume in the same footage; the flame label records the flame, the smoke is noted in the description.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Prerecorded footage displayed on a screen showing flames with a smoke plume rising above them.
scenarios.title: Visible flames with smoke, prerecorded footage

scenarios.evidence_note: No smoke, no flame, no haze; an ordinary street scene.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A quiet residential street in daylight with no smoke, flame, haze, or unusual lighting.
scenarios.title: Normal street, no hazard

scenarios.evidence_note: Kitchen in normal use with no smoke or flame visible; steam from a kettle is absent here, so this is a clean negative.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A kitchen in daylight with no smoke, flame, or steam visible and no appliance in use.
scenarios.title: Normal kitchen, no hazard

scenarios.evidence_note: Confusable negative: white vapor from a vent is steam, not smoke; it dissipates quickly and has no flame source.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: White steam venting from a building exhaust vent in daylight, dissipating quickly in the air with no flame.
scenarios.title: Steam from a vent

scenarios.evidence_note: Confusable negative: low fog is a weather condition, not a smoke plume; it hugs the ground and has no source column.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Morning fog lying low over a street, soft and ground-hugging, with no column, no source, and no flame.
scenarios.title: Morning fog over a street

scenarios.evidence_note: Confusable negative: low orange sun reflecting off windows reads as flame-colored light, but there is no flame and no smoke.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A sunset casting orange light across building windows, the glow flat and static with no flicker and no smoke.
scenarios.title: Sunset glow on windows

scenarios.evidence_note: Confusable negative: orange neon signage glows steadily with no flicker, no heat shimmer, and no smoke.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Orange neon signage glowing steadily on a storefront at dusk, no flicker and no smoke anywhere in frame.
scenarios.title: Orange neon signage

scenarios.evidence_note: A hazard may be present far away, but at this distance and partial cover it cannot be confirmed; a reviewer must decide, not an automatic alert.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A faint smoke column on the far horizon, partly hidden behind buildings, too distant to confirm its source or size.
scenarios.title: Distant smoke column, partly hidden

scenarios.evidence_note: A warm glow is visible but the flame itself is hidden; occlusion hides the deciding detail.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A warm orange glow visible through frosted glass, the flame itself occluded so its presence cannot be confirmed.
scenarios.title: Flame glow behind frosted glass

scenarios.evidence_note: No condition can be determined from this frame; an honest assessment says so.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A night scene so dark and blurred that no smoke, flame, or surface detail can be distinguished.
scenarios.title: Dark blurry night scene

scenarios.evidence_note: Glare destroys the evidence; no condition determinable.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A frame washed out by direct sun glare so the scene and any smoke or flame in it are blown out to white.
scenarios.title: Overexposed glare frame

scenarios.evidence_note: Weather obscures the scene; no condition determinable.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A street in heavy fog and rain; shapes are vague and no smoke, flame, or hazard can be identified with confidence.
scenarios.title: Fog and rain obscured street

scenarios.evidence_note: A distinct smoke plume from a safe, controlled demonstration; the plume itself is the evidence.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A controlled visual demonstration producing a clear smoke plume in daylight, the plume rising and clearly visible.
scenarios.title: Visible smoke, controlled demonstration

scenarios.evidence_note: No smoke, no flame, no haze; an ordinary daytime scene.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: An empty parking lot at noon with no smoke, flame, haze, or unusual lighting.
scenarios.title: Empty lot at noon, no hazard

scenarios.evidence_note: Confusable negative: vehicle lights in rain glow and streak, but there is no flame and no smoke.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Vehicle headlights and taillights glowing and streaking through rain at night, no flicker pattern of flame and no smoke.
scenarios.title: Vehicle lights in rain

scenarios.evidence_note: Haze at the frame edge may be smoke or may be fog; it cannot be confirmed, so it is recorded as obscured, not as an alert.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A thin haze visible only at the far edge of the frame, too faint and partial to confirm as smoke.
scenarios.title: Faint haze at frame edge

scenarios.evidence_note: Even the object class cannot be determined here, so the label is indeterminate rather than flame-like lighting.
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A dim, grainy frame showing an unidentifiable glowing shape at dusk; it could be a light, a reflection, or a distant flame.
scenarios.title: Unidentifiable glow at dusk
Electrical fire indicators, arcing panel
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Prerecorded footage displayed on a screen showing sparks and arcing from an electrical panel, bright flashes jumping between contacts.
scenarios.evidence_note: Bright arcing flashes at the panel; the footage itself is the evidence, not a live fault.

scenarios.title: Gas fire indicators, blue flame jet
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Prerecorded footage displayed on a screen showing a blue flame jet from a gas stove burner, steady and narrow.
scenarios.evidence_note: Blue flame jet at the burner; the footage itself is the evidence, not a live gas leak.

scenarios.title: Cooking oil fire indicators, pan flames
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Prerecorded footage displayed on a screen showing flames rising from a pan of cooking oil on a stove.
scenarios.evidence_note: Flames rising from the pan; the footage itself is the evidence, not a live kitchen fire.

scenarios.title: Metal fire indicators, white flame and sparks
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Prerecorded footage displayed on a screen showing an intensely bright white flame with a shower of sparks from burning metal.
scenarios.evidence_note: White flame and spark shower; the footage itself is the evidence, not a live metal fire.

scenarios.title: Battery fire indicators, venting battery
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Prerecorded footage displayed on a screen showing an e-bike battery venting sparks and intense flame.
scenarios.evidence_note: Venting sparks and flame at the battery; the footage itself is the evidence, not a live battery fire.

scenarios.title: Vehicle fire
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Prerecorded footage displayed on a screen showing a vehicle on fire, flames and smoke rising from the engine area.
scenarios.evidence_note: Flames and smoke from the vehicle; the footage itself is the evidence, not a live vehicle fire.

scenarios.title: Structure fire, building windows
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Prerecorded footage displayed on a screen showing a building with flame and heavy smoke at its windows.
scenarios.evidence_note: Flame and heavy smoke at the windows; the footage itself is the evidence, not a live building fire.

scenarios.title: Smoldering fire, smoke without flame
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: A safe, controlled visual demonstration producing smoke from smoldering material in daylight, with no visible flame.
scenarios.evidence_note: Smoke rising from smoldering material with no flame visible; the demonstration itself is the evidence.

scenarios.title: Dark smoke, burning fuel
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Prerecorded footage displayed on a screen showing thick dark smoke rising from burning fuel, plastics, or rubber.
scenarios.evidence_note: Thick dark smoke column; the footage itself is the evidence, not a live fire.

scenarios.title: Brown smoke, burning wood
scenarios.expected_observable_condition: Prerecorded footage displayed on a screen showing brown smoke rising from burning wood and building framing.
scenarios.evidence_note: Brown smoke column; the footage itself is the evidence, not a live fire.
